# FiguredoutAI

> FiguredoutAI LLP builds growth infrastructure for businesses with high
> enquiry volume — a conversational qualification layer that sorts, scores
> and routes incoming enquiries so revenue stops depending on headcount.
> Registered LLP (LLPIN ACZ-0822), Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India.
> Founded by Tanishk Singhal (CEO) and Yashvardhan Awasthi (CTO).

## Core
- [Decision Layer](https://figuredoutai.com/decision-layer/): What a decision layer is and how it differs from a chatbot
- [How It Works](https://figuredoutai.com/how-it-works/): The four-phase implementation process
- [Services](https://figuredoutai.com/services/): Qualification logic design, the decision layer, operating visibility
- [Use Cases](https://figuredoutai.com/use-cases/): Buyer-focused explanations of inbound lead intake, WhatsApp qualification, AI voice reception, sales workflow automation and CRM integration
- [Systems We’ve Built](https://figuredoutai.com/systems/): Interactive workflow examples, explicitly presented as demonstrations rather than client case studies
- [Why Us](https://figuredoutai.com/why-us/): How qualification logic is built rather than downloaded
- [Reference Build](https://figuredoutai.com/reference-build/): A decision layer we designed, built and own
- [About](https://figuredoutai.com/about/): Company, founders, and registered entity details
- [Contact](https://figuredoutai.com/contact/): Intake audit request
